Raye is nominated for her latest Mercury-winning record This Album May Contain Hope and its lead single Where Is My Husband!, which is up for both song and record of the year. Other nominees include Rosalía, Ella Langley, Olivia Dean, Ariana Grande, Bruno Mars, Taylor Swift, Olivia Rodrigo, Miranda Lambert and Phoebe Bridgers. Parton's two nominations, both in the best country duo/group performance category, come three months after the country music star died aged 80. Parton is recognised for Butterfly, her collaboration with the Zac Brown Band, and Light of a Clear Blue Morning, alongside an all-star line-up including her goddaughter Miley Cyrus. The late country star also received a nomination for best audio book, for her narration of Star of the Show: My Life on Stage. Mediante sus programas de asistencia técnica, la OIT ha orientado y apoyado al Gobierno en la formulación y aplicación de políticas que protegen a los trabajadores y promueven el diálogo social. Además de trabajar con el Gobierno de Granada en un plan de acción para brindar protección al sector informal, la OIT ha sido fundamental para el desarrollo de las PYME en Granada, proporcionando formación, asistencia técnica y acceso a los recursos, que desempeñan un papel clave para ayudar al empresariado local a establecer y acrecentar sus negocios. Este apoyo no solo crea oportunidades de trabajo y potencia el crecimiento económico, sino que también promueve un desarrollo sustentable e inclusivo. A través de sus continuos esfuerzos y de su colaboración con el Gobierno y los interlocutores sociales, la OIT contribuye a la construcción de un país más resiliente. The Dutchman was in tears after securing a remarkable, and thoroughly deserved, 10-8 victory in the second round in Wolverhampton. Having looked imperious as he won six legs on the spin to take a 7-2 lead, 16th seed Wattimena showed signs of nerves as the finish line approached, but dug in to stave off a late Littler comeback and progress to the quarter-finals. "I think I played really incredible, I played my best game on this stage and I'm really proud of it," an emotional Wattimena told Sky Sports. "He started playing well at the end. Last leg, [I had] one dart for the match - amazing." Wattimena finished with an average of 101.70 having hit a staggering 10 180s and, such was his level for the majority of the match, he might feel the margin of victory should have been more comfortable. The 38-year-old twice threatened nine-darters and had two darts for an 8-2 lead, with Littler rarely even given a look at a double. However, the 19-year-old world champion sensed an opportunity and showed his class with a 10-darter to break throw as Wattimena finally stuttered a leg from victory. pages.text: Grand Theft Auto staff 'caught red-handed' in confidentiality breach, tribunal hears Skip to content Site search Home News Sport Business Technology Health Culture Arts Travel Earth Audio Video Live Documentaries Weather Newsletters Watch Live Grand Theft Auto staff 'caught red-handed' in confidentiality breach, tribunal hears 48 minutes ago Share Save Add as preferred on Google Press Association A group of workers who were dismissed from Rockstar Games were "caught red-handed" flouting contractual policies and obligations, an employment tribunal has heard. The gaming giant behind Grand Theft Auto said it took action after staff discussed confidential information on a Discord server which had hundreds of members. It came during the company's closing speech in a case brought by former employees who are claiming unfair dismissal for trade union activities. A judgement is due at a later date. Representing 23 workers, the Independent Workers' Union of Great Britain (IWGB) said the former staff were penalised for discussing working conditions in a private online forum. The conclusion of evidence comes ahead of the release of the highly anticipated Grand Theft Auto 6 game on Thursday. It is expected to break sales records when it is released. Pre-orders of the game are already though to be worth hundreds of millions of pounds. When airport owners or sponsors, planning agencies, or other organizations accept funds from FAA-administered airport financial assistance programs, they must agree to certain obligations (or assurances). The assurances may be attached to the application or the grant for Federal assistance and become part of the final grant offer or in restrictive covenants to property deeds. The duration of these obligations depends on the type of recipient, the useful life of the facility being developed, and other conditions stipulated in the assurances. TopologicalSorter ( graph = None ) ¶ Provides functionality to topologically sort a graph of hashable nodes. A topological order is a linear ordering of the vertices in a graph such that for every directed edge u -> v from vertex u to vertex v, vertex u comes before vertex v in the ordering. For instance, the vertices of the graph may represent tasks to be performed, and the edges may represent constraints that one task must be performed before another; in this example, a topological ordering is just a valid sequence for the tasks. A complete topological ordering is possible if and only if the graph has no directed cycles, that is, if it is a directed acyclic graph. If the optional graph argument is provided it must be a dictionary representing a directed acyclic graph where the keys are nodes and the values are iterables of all predecessors of that node in the graph (the nodes that have edges that point to the value in the key). Additional nodes can be added to the graph using the add() method. Gray wolves have a circumpolar range including North America, Europe and Asia. The wide range of habitats in which wolves can thrive reflects their adaptability as a species and includes temperate forests, mountains, tundra, taiga, grasslands and deserts. In North America, wolves are primarily predators of medium and large hooved mammals, such as moose, elk, white-tailed deer, mule deer, caribou, muskox and bison. Gray wolves have long legs that are well adapted to running, allowing them to move fast and travel far in search of food, and large skulls and jaws that are well suited to catching and feeding on large mammals. Wolves also have keen senses of smell, hearing and vision, which they use to detect prey and one another. The Green Library Hub is a National Lottery-funded programme to support people to live more sustainably and take climate action. We’re working in partnership with the Chartered Institute of Library and Information Professionals (CILIP) and Camden Libraries to connect global climate challenges to local priorities in St Pancras, Somers Town and King’s Cross from energy efficiency and food resilience to healthier neighbourhoods and community wellbeing. How can you get involved with the Green Library Hub? You can take part in activities and workshops, including: regular climate cafés repair and making skills sessions advice on saving energy at home gardening and nature-based activities creative sessions for children and families. Our goal is to strengthen local resilience and create a toolkit that enables libraries across the UK to support their communities in taking climate action. How long will the Green Library Hub run? pages.text: Greenwich Giants host MLB Play Ball event with dinosaur theme Skip to Content The creature lies in wait. He stands with short arms close to his body, running in fits and starts and letting out sporadic roars while trying to grab hold of his target. No, he’s not a dinosaur. He’s an English child learning how to play baseball. For the Greenwich Giants , a community baseball club in Southeast London, “T-Rex T-Ball” is a way of life. It’s how children aged 4 to 7 get introduced to the sport. Baseball concepts are boiled down to dinosaur comparisons, with kids pretending to be a T-Rex as they learn an athletic catching stance. In other drills, kids impersonate other dinosaurs while practicing proper running and jumping techniques in the field. For the older kids, “Raptor Dash” provides additional running training. All of these methods were on display last Saturday at an MLB Play Ball Weekend event hosted by the Giants at the University of Greenwich. After the deputy mayor of Greenwich, Raja Zeeshan, opened with a ceremonial first pitch, over 150 children of all ages took part in a day full of baseball festivities. Some were members of the Giants, but for 122 kids, it was their first introduction to baseball. The Giants’ mascot, Gigi (who is technically a Giganotosaurus, slightly larger than a T-Rex) was on hand to play dinosaur-themed games with the younger children. Organized on a fixed 0.01-degree grid, approximately 1.2 square kilometers in North America, the Gridded EIF provides detailed demographic counts by age, sex, race and ethnicity as well as counts of the population by race and ethnicity and household income decile. Additionally, the Gridded EIF makes available exposure data for several key environmental hazards, including air pollution, on the same grid. By making this granular dataset accessible, we empower the research community to conduct advanced spatial analyses that yield deeper insights and surpass the capabilities of traditional aggregated place-based data studies, all while upholding the strictest confidentiality standards. The percentage that GDP grew (or shrank) from one period to another is an important way for Americans to gauge how their economy is doing. GDP is the signature piece of BEA's National Income and Product Accounts, which measure the value and makeup of the nation's output, the types of income generated, and how that income is used. Applying a function to each group independently. Combining the results into a data structure. Out of these, the split step is the most straightforward. In the apply step, we might wish to do one of the following: Aggregation : compute a summary statistic (or statistics) for each group. Some examples: Compute group sums or means. Compute group sizes / counts. Transformation : perform some group-specific computations and return a like-indexed object. Some examples: Standardize data (zscore) within a group. Filling NAs within groups with a value derived from each group. Filtration : discard some groups, according to a group-wise computation that evaluates to True or False. Some examples: Discard data that belong to groups with only a few members. Filter out data based on the group sum or mean. Many of these operations are defined on GroupBy objects. These operations are similar to those of the aggregating API , window API , and resample API . pages.text: Group Portraits - Rijksmuseum Subject Group Portraits In the 17th century the powerful cities of the Netherlands were responsible for their own protection, and many group portraits were painted of the civic guards who maintained order and security. Read more All adult men were expected to join such a militia until the age of 60, as long as they were able to buy their own armour. The group portraits were a costly exercise as each member was required to pay for their own portrait. The style of the earliest militia group portraits, painted in the 16th century, was rather static. Over the course of the 17th century, artists developed an increasingly loose compositional style that reached its pinnacle with Rembrandt’s The Night Watch and the lively Banquet of the Amsterdam Civic Guard by Bartholomeus van der Helst. Aside from militias, other municipal, provincial and national organisations, as well as individuals, commissioned group portraits. Se creó en 2015 para contribuir a asegurar que la OIT cuente con un corpus claro, sólido y actualizado de normas internacionales del trabajo que responda a la evolución del mundo del trabajo, con el propósito de proteger a los trabajadores y teniendo presentes las necesidades de las empresas sostenibles. Los 32 miembros se reúnen durante una semana cada año para examinar las normas internacionales del trabajo por subtemas. Esto implica tres tareas concretas: clasificar las normas como "actualizadas", "que requieren medidas adicionales para asegurar su relevancia continua y futura" u "superadas"; identificar las lagunas en materia de cobertura, con inclusión de las que requieren la adopción de nuevas normas; y recomendar medidas de seguimiento con plazos definidos, cuando proceda. El Consejo de Administración ha aprobado todas las recomendaciones formuladas por el GTT del MEN en sus últimas reuniones y ha pedido a la Organización que las aplique con carácter de prioridad institucional.
